name: Savior of the People (Achievement)
body:
You have championed the meek, healed the sick, and carried your light into the darkest of places.

Prerequisite: Lay on hands class feature. Use your lay on hands ability to cure a cumulative total of 500 points of damage to non-combatants or to allies outside of combat.

Benefit: When you use your lay on hands class feature, the amount of damage you heal is increased by half.
